FIVEELEMENTS-RELIC1.description: At the start of each combat, add [gold]Creation[/gold] into your hand. Also teach you how [gold]Elements[/gold] work.
FIVEELEMENTS-RELIC1.title: Apprentice Tome
FIVEELEMENTS-RELIC2.description:
At the start of each combat, add [gold]Creation+[/gold] into your hand.
Trigger the corresponding effect on the card [gold]Activation[/gold] when you gain an [gold]Essence[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-RELIC2.title: Master Tome

FIVEELEMENTS-WATER_RELIC.description: Now [gold]Wave[/gold] deal damage at the end of your turn.
FIVEELEMENTS-WATER_RELIC.title: Water Relic
FIVEELEMENTS-WOOD_RELIC.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy if you played a [gold]Wood[/gold] card this turn.
FIVEELEMENTS-WOOD_RELIC.title: Wood Relic
FIVEELEMENTS-FIRE_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Fire Plume[/gold] into your hand.
FIVEELEMENTS-FIRE_RELIC.title: Fire Relic
FIVEELEMENTS-EARTH_RELIC.description: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Earth[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-EARTH_RELIC.title: Earth Relic
FIVEELEMENTS-METAL_RELIC.description: At the start of your turn, gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-METAL_RELIC.title: Metal Relic
FIVEELEMENTS-NEUTRAL_RELIC.description: Each turn the first time you play a card of each [gold]Element[/gold], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
FIVEELEMENTS-NEUTRAL_RELIC.title: Neutral Relic
